scope: G6 USB interrupt endpoint 0x85 parameter notifications

id_space.note: 0x9600 two-byte reading is arithmetically equivalent but the 0x96 tag is constant and carries no per-parameter information; no factory file uses a 0x96xx namespace.

confirmed.evidence: frame 37310 (SBX off) = 0.0; frame 58555 (SBX on) = 1.0; frame 8217 (Scout on) = 0.0, matching SoundCoreScoutFeature forcing SBX master off

confirmed.caveat: single observation, no single-variable differential test yet

unmapped_ids: all remaining observed ids have value 0.0, semantics unknown

refuted_candidates.verdict: structurally closest (flat device parameter table) but VT1728/AE-9 numbering
MIDL metadata only: names without numeric values

excluded_misread.why: identical for SBX and Scout, while _etParamEfxMasterControl assigns them 7 and 6; therefore a shared command selector, not a parameter id

next_step: Single-variable differential capture: change exactly one parameter (e.g. SmartVol 74 -> 50) and diff the ids whose float value changes.

reproducibility.managed: 36 assemblies decompiled; Constant table read via dnfile; ConstantRow.Value must be decoded as little-endian raw_data[1:] (calibrated against _etFeature and _etParamEfxMasterControl)
reproducibility.native: SndCrUSB.DLL MIDL metadata block 0x300000-0x390000, 441 records / 79 blocks; record = [len][xx xx xx] <name> [u32 block][u32 string offset or 0xFFFFFFFF]
